title: Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA)
summary: Spinal muscular atrophy affects the nerve cells that control muscles, which leads to muscle weakness. How serious it is varies a lot between types.
inheritance_plain: It is inherited in an autosomal recessive way: a child is affected only if they get a changed copy of the SMN1 gene from both parents.
carrier_meaning: A carrier has one changed copy. Carriers are healthy. A small number of carriers are not picked up by standard tests, which a counsellor can explain.
disease_meaning: A person with two changed copies has SMA. New treatments now exist, and early diagnosis matters, so specialist care is important.
screening: A carrier test can be done with a blood sample.
